title: Two Attackers, No Escape
setup: Your bishop on d3 stands in front of your own rook, and the black rook on d5 is in both their way.
hint: Your bishop is blocking your own rook. Where can it go so that the black rook still cannot move a square?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Be4}} does two jobs at once. It pins the rook on **d5** to the king on **b7**, and by leaving d3 it lets your rook on **d2** attack d5 as well. Two attackers, no defenders, and a rook that is not allowed to move.
